SELECT r.id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.description, r.sort_order, r.status, r.create_time, r.update_time
FROM sys_role r
INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON r.id = ur.role_id
WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
AND r.is_deleted = 0

SELECT
id, role_name, role_code, description, sort_order, status, create_time, update_time
FROM sys_role
WHERE is_deleted = 0
ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
